subject: Game Theory
title: The Traveler's Dilemma
description: Learn The Traveler's Dilemma in one minute.

hook.text: Two travelers lose identical luggage. The airline asks each to claim a value between $2 and $100.

buildup.text: If both claim the same, both get it. If claims differ, the lower wins a bonus from the higher.

discovery.text: Nash equilibrium says both should claim $2. But in experiments, most people claim $95 or higher.

twist.text: The 'rational' answer of $2 is so absurd that real humans ignore it. Intuition beats strict logic.

climax.text: Economist Kaushik Basu designed this game to show Nash equilibrium can fail spectacularly.

quiz.question: What do most real participants claim?
